newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: Macedonia expects $10 mln from air traffic control.
newsitem.headline: Macedonia expects $10 mln from air traffic control.

text.p: Macedonia expects turnover of around $10 million per year from air traffic control, Jovica Lazarevski, assistant director of Macedonian civil aviation directorate, told Reuters on Friday.
Macedonia took over full control of the country's air space at midnight on Thursday, five years following its declaration of independence from former Yugoslavia.
Until now air traffic control over Macedonia, including the zone above 7,000 metres, was in the jurisdiction of Yugoslav air traffic controllers.
"We expect undeterred functioning of the system, payments for technical equipment and further development of the Macedonian air control system," Lazarevski said.
During winter around 200-250 planes fly over Macedonia daily and up to 600 during summer months.
